open_points.subject: execute_function channel-over-bound outcome versus judge_execution outcome ordering
open_points.text: when the runner writes more it stops reading, kills the environment as for its wall deadline, decodes what it read and observes channel_over_bound, so the execution concludes resource_exhausted.
open_points.other_text: timeout when the deadline passed; resource_exhausted when the report's resource_hit is true — the runner hit its memory, process or scratch limit, the scratch limit being the imported RELEASE_CEILING_SANDBOX_SCRATCH_BYTES_MAX constant, which runner_arguments writes as file_size_limit into the runner's command line and which is no field of ResourceBounds or RunnerLaunch —, the observation's channel_over_bound holds, or the output count exceeds bounds.output_bytes;
open_points.question: Must channel_over_bound always conclude resource_exhausted, or does timeout take precedence when the deadline also passed?

open_points.subject: execute_function channel-over-bound outcome versus unconfirmed-cleanup override
open_points.text: when the runner writes more it stops reading, kills the environment as for its wall deadline, decodes what it read and observes channel_over_bound, so the execution concludes resource_exhausted.
open_points.other_text: When cleanup was not confirmed the outputs are discarded and the result is outcome crashed with detail_code cleanup_failed of = models.DetailCode, whatever else was observed.
open_points.question: Must channel_over_bound conclude resource_exhausted even when cleanup is unconfirmed, or must cleanup_failed override it with crashed?
